hero.name: Nithin S P
hero.intro:
Hi, I’m Nithin S P, a passionate Graphic Designer and Full Stack Developer who enjoys combining creativity with technology. I specialize in graphic design, photo editing, branding, digital artwork, and web development, creating visually appealing designs and functional digital experiences.

I’m always eager to learn, explore new technologies, and turn ideas into creative and practical solutions.

about.title: Developer mindset. Designer eye.
paragraphs: I’m Nithin S P, a passionate Graphic Designer and Full Stack Developer with a strong interest in combining creativity and technology to build impactful digital experiences.

As a Graphic Designer, I work with Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and CorelDRAW to create professional and visually appealing designs. My experience includes posters, social media creatives, branding, logos, promotional materials, photo editing, digital artwork, and print-ready designs.

Alongside design, I’m also a Full Stack Developer with knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, and Django. I enjoy developing responsive websites and web applications with clean interfaces and practical functionality.

My combination of design and development skills allows me to understand both the visual and technical sides of a project—from creating the initial design concept to developing it into a functional web experience.
I’m continuously learning new tools, technologies, and creative techniques to improve my skills and deliver high-quality, creative, and user-focused solutions.
